observations: body L1, L9, L15, L27: «وقد» (L1), «منها» (L9), «هذا» (L15) and «وأردنا» (L27) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L9: the line is one Arabic run, read from the right, ending in the points «.....» at its left end; the point at its right end is the full stop of the Latin sentence, set after the run.
body L13, L20, L23: «وَتَرُ» (L13) has fatha, fatha and damma; «وَتَر» (L20) is printed with two fathas and no vowel on the r.
body L20, L24: «راجعا» (L20) is printed without the tanwīn that «راجعًا» has in L21-L24.
body L28: «ص» is the abjad numeral 60 («excedens 60ᵖ»).
body L33: a speck is printed between «eritque» and «sinus»; not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
